figure.description: File name of the reviewed image.

verdict.description: blocked if any finding is blocking; revise if any is major; otherwise ship.

findings.description: One entry per rule violated. Empty if none.

rule.description: Rule identifier from docs/figure-contract.md, e.g. C7 or A4.

observed.description: What is actually in the figure or sidecar. Not a restatement of the rule.

fix.description: Smallest change that satisfies the rule. After pass 2, names the line.

script_only.description: True if this was invisible from the image and sidecar and only surfaced on reading the script.

rules_passed.description: Rule identifiers checked and satisfied, so the rubric can be audited.

sidecar_consistency.description: Places where the image contradicts what the sidecar declares. Empty if consistent.

title_overstates.description: True if the title asserts more than the study design supports (C12).

notes.description: Optional. Anything the structured fields cannot carry.
